theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_projection_algebra
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ), (∀ (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N) (y : Euclid N), ‖A y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i : Fin N, ‖A (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) * ‖y‖ ^ 2) ∧ (∀ Q S T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid N), ∑ i : Fin N, ‖S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - T.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ∑ i : Fin N, ‖Q.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ∑ i : Fin N, ‖Q.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - T.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∧ (∀ (Q T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid N)) (a b : Euclid N), a ∈ T → b ∈ T → |inner ℝ (Q.starProjection a) b - inner ℝ a b| ≤ (∑ i : Fin N, ‖Q.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - T.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖) ∧ ∀ (Q T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid N)) (e : Euclid N), e ∈ Tᗮ → ‖Q.starProjection e‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i : Fin N, ‖Q.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - T.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) * ‖e‖ ^ 2
